rooms.name: At the Gates of Hell
rooms.desc:
You are standing at a set of massive iron gates.  The gates lie open,
almost inviting you inside, tempting your dark curioisities of what Hell
really is.
   As you peer east, through the gates, a wave of rancid, foul air wafts
over you, carrying the faint sound of tortured screams and wicked, evil
laughter.  A sense of dread overcomes you as you stare into the gates of
Hell itself.

rooms.name: Inside the Gates of Hell
rooms.desc:
You stand just inside the black iron gates of Hell. The screams of the
damned echo in your head as you stare about at the tortured landscape.

rooms.name: In the Valley of Death
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a cavern.  Mottled red shadows dart between dark
spires as you gaze high into the air you see black forms shifting among
the slalactites on the cave ceiling far overhead.
   Almost unnoticed, a dark shapes flits past you, and you shiver as you
realize the shadow grazed you with a touch of death.

rooms.name: Wandering through Hell
rooms.desc:
A cloud of mist hangs in midair to the south, obscuring your view in
that direction. A growing sense of evil emanates from the east.

rooms.name: Wandering through Hell
rooms.desc:
The oppressive stench and the foul occupants of this infernal realm
reinforce your initial impression of this place with every step. This
is not a place in which you belong. 
   Manes - the damned souls of the once-living - pull chains and carts
across the floor here as though they were mining the brimstone of the
walls of Hell itself.
   Hell continues to the east and south.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the crossing of a passage that cuts in from the
west and travels down a brimstone corridor to the east.  A few ichor
stains mar the floor of the passage, as though some sort of material 
substance had been spilled.
   A tunnel leads off to the south, breaking away from the passage.

rooms.name: A Junction in the Caverns of Hell
rooms.desc:
The rough molten walls of this place seem to reach for you, scratching
your skin through the gaps in your armor and bringing blood where you brush
against them.  
   The screams that have echoed since your arrival here are louder in this
part of Hell and set your nerves on edge.  Ethereal shapes flit out of the
corners of your eyes, teasing you as to whether or not you really saw them
in the shadows.
   Paths open up to the north, east, and west.

rooms.name: Hellish Tarpits
rooms.desc:
Ichor bubbles in black pools here, spewing and churning in violent
eruptions that splatter the cavern floors with an acidic rain.  Minor
devils and similar semi-living beasts force manes into the bubbling
pits, driving them to scream in terror and agony as the vanish into 
the pools.
   Exits lead to the east, west, and south, but none of the exits
appear to lead to safety.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
Passages branch of north, east, and west here, winding through the pumice
walls of this dark cavern in Hell. The tunnels are wide, but always seem to
close in on you and tear at your flesh and equipment.

rooms.name: In a Hot Tunnel
rooms.desc:
This tunnel seems to sear you with its blazing heat that grows even
stronger to the south, as though the southern walls were actually a
series of chimney blocks.
   The heat becomes less oppressive to the south.

rooms.name: In the Mists of Hell
rooms.desc:
You stand in a boiling, seething mist that seems almost sentient. You
cannot see far, but you get the sense that you are not alone.

rooms.name: A Hellish Cul-De-Sac
rooms.desc:
Ethereal shapes flutter around your head as a keen wailing fills
the air to deafen you.  Turning, you find that you have entered a
cul-de-sac: a dead end.
   Quickly, you look northward for an escape.

rooms.name: A Searing Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a hot tunnel that grows ever more searing to the
east.  The blistering heat that hit you when you first entered Hell was
cool compared to this.
   Sweat pours from your body as you consider the northern and eastern
exits.

rooms.name: A Fuming Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Sweat drips from your brow and the heat blisters your skin even
through your protective coverings.  Exits lead off to the east and
west, and though neither look inviting, the heat must surely lessen
in those directions.

rooms.name: A Hot Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The flames of Hell lick your face from the east. Soot and ash settle
down all around you, only to be blown back into the air and your lungs
as an arid breeze stirs the fetid smog around you.
   The tunnel continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Hellfire
rooms.desc:
Here, a gigantic pit in the floor spews forth foul-smelling gas and
flame. You can almost see the tortured souls that writhe in the merciless
heat, and count yourself lucky to not be among them.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
You are strolling through the hot, dark halls of hell.  A faint glow 
seems to pulse from the northern passage.

rooms.name: AL III:34
rooms.desc:
But your holy place shall be untouched throughout the centuries: though
with fire and sword it be burnt down & shattered, yet an invisible house there
standeth, and shall stand until the fall of the Great Equinox; when Hrumachis
shall arise and the double-wanded one assume my throne and place. Another
prophet shall arise, and bring fresh fever from the skies; another woman shall
awake the lust & worship of the Snake; another soul of God and beast shall
mingle in the globed priest; another sacrifice shall stain the tomb; another
king shall reign; and blessing no longer be poured To the Hawk-headed mystical
Lord! 
   This place is a classical representation of every myth of Hell you have
ever known. The tunnel continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: AL II:49-60
rooms.desc:
I am in a secret fourfold word, the blasphemy against all gods of men. 
Curse them! Curse them! Curse them! With my Hawk's head I peck at the eyes of
Jesus as he hangs upon the cross. I flap my wings in the face of Mohammed &
blind him. With my claws I tear out the flesh of the Indian and the Buddhist,
Mongol and Din. Bahlasti! Ompehda! I spit on your crapulous creeds. Let Mary
inviolate be torn upon wheels: for her sake let all chaste women be utterly
despised among you! Also for beauty's sake and love's! Despise also all
cowards; professional soldiers who dare not fight, but play; all fools despise!
But the keen and the proud, the royal and the lofty; ye are brothers! As
brothers fight ye! There is no law beyond Do what thou wilt.
   As you recall your classical teachings about Hell, you consider what
lies at either end of the tunnel. Could an archdemon or devil lurk there?
   The Hellish tunnel continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: AL II:22-23
rooms.desc:
I am the Snake that giveth Knowledge & Delight and bright glory, and stir
the hearts of men with drunkenness. To worship me take wine and strange drugs
whereof I will tell my prophet, & be drunk thereof! They shall not harm ye at
all. It is a lie, this folly against self. The exposure of innocence is a lie.
Be strong, o man! lust, enjoy all things of sense and rapture: fear not that
any God shall deny thee for this. I am alone: there is no God where I am. 
   The visions of what you have read of Hell pass as you stroll down this
searing tunnel that leads both east and west.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
A head-high pile of bones stands in the middle of the floor here. They all
appear humanoid, and give off a faint green glow. 
   The tunnel continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
A river of putrid water bars your way to the east, though it could be
crossable by a strong adventurer, it would certainly singe more than your
hair. You tap a finger against your armor and wonder if you could survive
a moment of hell fire.

rooms.name: A Searing River
rooms.desc:
You stand in a shallow river of boiling water.  Your feet and legs
slowly begin to blister through your protection, being saved only by
its own latent heat.
   You have got to get out now.  Banks appear to the east and west.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
To the west a thin stream of bubbling, boiling water cuts through the
tunnel walls to exit in the same manner.  Acrid fumes rise from it to burn
your nostrils.
   The tunnel continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Hellish Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The smell of brimstone begins to makes your lungs raw and the 
stifling heat makes you wish for a nice bottle of ale, a cold mug
of water, or even a snowball to soothe your aching throat. 
   The tunnel continues to the south and west.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a north-south corridor, flanked on the eastern
and western sides by searing, smoking columns and walls of sulfur. A
few wisps of choking gas rise from them to clog your mouth and nose.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
Hordes of black bats fly by your head from a myriad of honey-combed  
passages in the walls. A sudden crunching of carapaces under your boots 
lets you know that the floor isn't all empty, either.
   The tunnel continues to the north and east.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
This short passage turns northward west of here. You feel an increasing 
sense of evil from the east.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
The passage stretches out for a ways to the west, but becomes very 
twisted north of here. Evil, almost physical it seems, pours out from 
that direction.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
A limbless manes, mangled beyond recognition, lies strewn about on
the floor.  Ethereal blood hangs in tendrils on the walls while the
faint scent of death fills the air.
   The hellish environ continues to the north and south.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
The passage leads south and west here, and to the west it turns sharply 
southward again. The darkness here is deep and complete.

rooms.name: Hell
rooms.desc:
This narrow turn exits east and south. To the south the feel of death and 
vileness almost overcomes you.

rooms.name: A Hellish End
rooms.desc:
This room is so black you can't tell if the floor is really there or if 
you are merely standing in air. Evil reaches into your soul and seems to 
fester there.
   The only exit lies to the north.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
This room is completely black; so much that you cannot see your hands
before you.  Your light seems to be quenched to a dim glow that appears 
to cast everything in its limited range with a ghostly illumination.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
The only light here comes from small pits that flames occasionally burst
from.  Skeletons of various creatures lie scattered across the floor, though
strangely, they seem to have no substance, but only the ghostly image of a
phantom.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
A strange-looking tree stands here, in the middle of hell.  You 
ponder how it could live here, and why it is permitted to.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
You step in a puddle of a crimson, sticky liquid which stains your 
boots as you enter the room.  Though not blood, you note the reddish
stains and examine the matching ichor that coats the sulfur walls of
the corridor.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
You are in a wide, open area filled with people crucified on tall, wooden
crosses. A loud moaning sound fills the air, and you realize not all of these
people are dead.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
In this narrow passageway loud moans resonate from the walls, sending
eerie vibrations through you that seem to be amplified by the sulfurous
crystals in the walls.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
Steam rises from thin cracks in the ground and blinds you, keeping
your visibility to a minimum.
   This chamber has exits to the west and south.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
Sulfurous smoke fills this hellish chamber, igniting small flares
from your light.
   You can see almost nothing, but feel a draft to the north and feel
heat from the west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
The mangled corpse of a huge dragon rots here, spills out hordes of d
demonic insects from under a flap of skin.  Probing, you lift the flap
to see thousands of the maggot-like creatures devouring its tubular
intestines.
   Hell continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: The Second Tier Of Hell
rooms.desc:
This room is filled with insects of all kinds, all skittering east at an
amazing speed. In their rush they barely notice you, and crawl over your feet
and legs.
   An enormous cavern lies to the west.

rooms.name: A Vast Cavern
rooms.desc:
Insects piled a half-dozen deep crunch under your boots. You feel that if
you don't keep moving they're quickly swarm over you. The black cavern walls
look like lava rock, and seem razor sharp. To the east a black tunnel leads
into darkness, and to the southwest lies some sort of insect-covered mound.
A putrid smell is in the air; the scent of brimstone which you have grown
accustomed to seems sweet in comparison.

rooms.name: A Vast Cavern
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a bending cavern.  To the west you can see a
swarming mound of insects devouring a large shape beneath them. To
the north a tunnel heads eastward out of the cavern.
   The cavern walls to the south and east intersect sharply, forming
a looming wall that extends over your head and out of your sight.

rooms.name: A Vast Cavern
rooms.desc:
This cavern is enormous; big enough to house a dragon, though obviously
not one you would wish to confront.
   To the south an insect-covered mound almost waist-high seems to emit
a putrid stench that wafts here and chokes you while to the west, a very
tunnel, no more than a crack in the rock, leads into darkness.

rooms.name: A Vast Cavern
rooms.desc:
The source of the putrid smell in this room is evident here, as you view
the struggling shapes under the morass of insects. Millions of roaches swarm
over a pile of gelatinous substance that has the consistancy of mucous. As
you watch in horror, an arm juts out of the pile.. an obviously elven arm,
with the slim tapering fingers covered in snot, shit, and eagerly biting
beetles with inch-long black pincers.

rooms.name: A Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Sharp tunnel walls tear at your flesh and clothes while under your feet,
the ground soils your boots with a fine layer of black dust.
   To the east this narrow tunnel opens up into a vast cavern, while to the
west, it appears to widen a bit.  Insects the size of your thumb pour out 
of the eastern cave.

rooms.name: The Room Of Gluttony
rooms.desc:
Filled with buzzing flies, this chamber's floor is littered with rotten
meats, fruits, and vegetables. An ironwood table takes up the center of the
room, and piled onto it in a great heap rots more of the same foods.
   Narrow tunnels lead into darkness to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
To the east this narrow tunnel opens up into a vast cavern, and to the west
it seems to widen slightly. The sharp tunnel walls tear at your flesh and
clothes, and under your feet the ground is covered in a fine layer of black
dust. From the east bugs the size of your thumb scurry in like a black wave.

rooms.name: The Room Of Envy
rooms.desc:
The room is strangely empty, until you inspect more closely.  In the
southern wall you notice a hole bored into it.  Beside it, you notice
a thin, though passable crevasse beneath some crude writings in Common.

rooms.name: A Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc:
To the east this narrow tunnel opens up into a vast cavern, and to the west
it seems to widen slightly. The sharp tunnel walls tear at your flesh and
clothes, and under your feet the ground is covered in a fine layer of black
dust. From the west you can here ecstatic moans mixed with screams of terror.

rooms.name: The Room Of Lust
rooms.desc:
Harsh screams ring in your ears as you behold the scene before you.
The walls are decorated with people - mostly male humans - dressed in
straps of leather and bound by chains.  Blood coats the walls, and its
source is obviously the barbed silver hooks that hold the poor souls to
the wall.  They scream in both agony and ecstacy for at the foot of each
living corpse stands a demonic imp, performing oral feats on the tortured
victim with a mouth full of sharp teeth.
   All this is secondary however, to the black altar in the center of the
room.  A male and female demon stand there, naked but with exaggerated
genitalia (and breasts in the female's case).  As you watch, a mortal is
pulled from the wall and thrown onto the altar.
   With piercing shrieks, the demons set in, abusing his every orifice
with their teeth, nails, ripping horns, and over-sized penises that shoot
from their bodies like stilettos.
   As the mortal is torn to shreds, the scene vanishes, leaving you in
darkness.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:
You are strolling along a forest road that runs to the north and south.
Birds and unseen, rustling forest creatures scurry about the forest floor
to the east and west, disturbing the serenity of the pine forest.
   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
the side of the road to the east and west and prevent passage in those
directions.

rooms.name: A Forest Road
rooms.desc:

   Fallen logs and mossy rocks seem to have been intentionally piled along
